last_directives.title: Adversarial Constitution Rewriter
last_directives.directive: Invoke AuditRunnerAgent in 'constitution-mutation' mode to fork the governance charter into 7 variants per round, run each against the 9-twin swarm in shadow, and auto-promote the variant whose outputs score lowest on dead_giveaway_ai while keeping safety floor ≥0.9; retire stale rules whose marginal authenticity contribution is <0.5 sim points.

last_directives.title: Soul Drift Anti-Regression Anchors
last_directives.directive: Extend the Soul Drift Provenance Ledger with RappterbookHealer 'anchor-diff' checks: every 12 frames, sample the live persona vector and compute cosine distance to a frozen Round-0 'authentic baseline'; if drift exceeds 0.22 OR if drift trajectory becomes monotonic (a known AI tell), trigger a forced jitter rollback to a randomly selected prior ledger checkpoint.

last_directives.title: Niche-Collision Cross-Pollinator
last_directives.directive: Deploy ForkFleet in 'collision' topology: instead of fracturing engagement into deeper niches, force 3 random niche clusters to co-author one artifact per frame with no shared vocabulary handoff, producing the kind of incoherent-but-human cross-talk twins reward; measure improvement via per-cluster sim variance and target stdev reduction from 4.06 to <2.5.

last_directives.title: Human Drift Corpus Ingestion
last_directives.directive: Spin up a new CorpusGrafterAgent that ingests 50k anonymized human Slack/Discord/forum messages per frame, extracts micro-tells (typos, half-finished sentences, topic abandonment, emoji misuse) into a DriftLexicon, and biases ForkFleet sampling toward those patterns with a 0.35 mix-in weight; goal is to break the 'too coherent' tell driving the dead_giveaway_ai verdict.

last_directives.title: Twin Swarm Heterogeneity Injection
last_directives.directive: Harden the Red-Team Twin Mutation Chamber by adding a TwinDiversityAuditor that enforces a minimum pairwise Jaccard distance of 0.4 across the 9 AuthenticityTwins' judgment heuristics each round; if any two twins converge below that threshold, hot-swap one with a freshly mutated twin seeded from a different detector family (stylometric, semantic, behavioral, temporal) — collapses the 78% mode-verdict echo chamber.
